description: Canonical route metadata for Alex Ford Adventures. Raw GeoJSON preserves imported geometry; this file defines public ownership, provenance, privacy treatment, and route-quality expectations.

provenanceTypes.personal-gps: Geometry recorded by Alex through Strava/GPS and suitable for public display.
provenanceTypes.historical-course: Historical or published event-course geometry, not represented as Alex's personal GPS track.
provenanceTypes.location-only: No route geometry is published; the record is represented by a place or venue marker.
provenanceTypes.privacy-withheld: Personal geometry exists but is intentionally not published for privacy.
